wifi.title: WiFi & Connectivity
wifi.qr.hint: Scan the QR code with your camera to connect automatically
wifi.streaming.title: Streaming Services
wifi.streaming.body: Netflix and Amazon Prime Video are installed on the TV. Please log in with your own account to enjoy. Please log out after use.
equipment.title: Equipment Guide
equipment.theater.title: 75" Theater & 5.1ch Surround
equipment.theater.steps:
• Turn on the TV with the remote control
  • Turn on the sound system as well
  • Select an app from Netflix etc. or the Home button
  • Adjust the volume with the volume buttons on the remote
equipment.teppan.title: BALMUDA The Plate Pro
equipment.teppan.steps:
• Place the plate on the main unit
  • Plug the power cord into an outlet
  • Adjust the temperature dial and preheat (approx. 3 min)
  • Cook your favorite ingredients and enjoy
  • After use, wipe with a damp cloth once the plate has cooled
equipment.kitchen.title: Kitchen
equipment.kitchen.body: The kitchen is equipped with an IH stove, microwave, refrigerator, toaster, and basic cookware and tableware. Please bring your own seasonings.
equipment.deck.title: Wood Deck
equipment.deck.sub: Private deck with panoramic countryside views
equipment.deck.body: The deck chairs and table have protective covers. Please remove the covers before use. At night, insects may be attracted to indoor lights — dim indoor lighting and use the deck lights instead.
equipment.bath.title: Bathroom & Amenities
equipment.bath.body: Bath towels, face towels, shampoo, conditioner, body soap, and a hair dryer are provided. No additional towels are available.
rules.title: House Rules
rules.nosmoking.title: No Smoking
rules.nosmoking.body: Smoking, including e-cigarettes, is prohibited inside the building. If you wish to smoke, please do so outside the building using your own portable ashtray
rules.quiet.title: Quiet Hours
rules.quiet.body: Please keep noise levels down on the deck after 10 PM
rules.trash.title: Waste Separation
rules.trash.body: Bins in the kitchen are labeled. Please separate: burnable, bottles, cans, and PET bottles
rules.checkoutinfo.title: Before Check-out
rules.checkoutinfo.body: Please wash used dishes and cookware, and place them on the sink drying rack or return them to their original location. Turn off A/C and lights, and lock all windows
rules.pets.title: No Pets
rules.pets.body: Pets are not allowed on the premises
rules.emergency.title: Emergency Contacts
nearby.title: Nearby Guide
nearby.nature.title: 🌊 Lake Biwa & Nature
nearby.lake.title: Lake Biwa Shore
nearby.lake.desc: About 5 minutes walk. Perfect for strolling and sunset viewing
nearby.metasequoia.title: Metasequoia Avenue
nearby.metasequoia.desc: A beautiful 2.4km tree-lined avenue with stunning seasonal scenery
nearby.sightseeing.title: ⛩️ Sightseeing
nearby.shirahige.title: Shirahige Shrine
nearby.shirahige.desc: Famous for its torii gate standing in the lake. A popular photo spot
nearby.shinasahi.title: Shinasahi Iris Garden
nearby.shinasahi.desc: Around 200 varieties and 200,000 irises bloom in June
nearby.shopping.title: 🛒 Shopping & Dining
nearby.super.title: Supermarket (Heiwado)
nearby.convenience.title: Convenience Store
nearby.onsen.title: ♨️ Hot Springs
nearby.onsen.name: Kutsuki Onsen Tenkuu
nearby.onsen.desc: Day-trip hot spring surrounded by nature
nearby.onsen2.name: Takarabune Onsen
nearby.onsen2.desc: Lakeside hot spring inn on Lake Biwa. Day-trip bathing available
nearby.leisure.title: 🏌️ Leisure
nearby.leisure.golf.title: Kutsuki Golf Club
nearby.leisure.golf.desc: Golf course surrounded by nature with views of the Takashima mountains
nearby.leisure.beach.title: Shirahige-hama Beach
nearby.leisure.beach.desc: Beautiful sandy beach on Lake Biwa. Perfect for summer lake swimming
nearby.leisure.lakesports.title: Makino Sunny Beach
nearby.leisure.lakesports.desc: Beach offering SUP, kayaking and other lake sports
nearby.leisure.valley.title: Biwako Valley
nearby.leisure.valley.desc: Scenic terrace with panoramic Lake Biwa views in summer; skiing & snowboarding in winter
access.title: Getting Here
access.address.title: Address
access.car.title: 🚗 By Car
access.car.list:
• From Osaka: Meishin Expressway → Kyoto-Higashi IC → Kosei Road → ~90 min
  • From Kyoto: Via Kosei Road → ~60 min
  • Parking: 2 spaces on premises (free)
access.train.title: 🚃 By Train
access.train.list:
• JR Kosei Line, get off at Shin-Asahi Station
  • Taxi from station: ~10 min
  • From Osaka Station to Shin-Asahi: ~90 min (JR Special Rapid → transfer at Omi-Imazu)
